desk.headline: Revenue up 61% y/y to $369m, EPS $0.68; Q4 tanker spot rates booked at records

other.label: Net income to shareholders
other.change: vs $29.6m a year ago, $69.5m in Q2

other.label: Teekay Parent cash and short-term investments
Market value of Teekay Tankers stake

results: Revenue rose 61% from a year ago to $369m but was 3% below Q2 ($379m).
Net income attributable to shareholders doubled y/y to $59.8m ($0.68 a share), including $0.07 a share from vessel-sale gains.
Mid-size crude tanker spot rates stayed at historic highs, averaging $106,400/day for Suezmaxes and $67,600/day for Aframax/LR2s.
Teekay Tankers ordered four newbuild tankers for 2030 delivery and agreed to buy a 2020-built MR tanker; it kept its $0.25 quarterly dividend.

guidance.summary: Teekay gives no formal guidance. It said Q4 spot bookings so far are at records: about $272,000/day for Suezmaxes (63% of days booked) and $208,300/day for Aframax/LR2s (53% booked).

watch: Whether record Q4 spot rates hold for the rest of the quarter.
Value of the Teekay Tankers stake, which drives Teekay Parent's worth.
Progress on the fleet renewal and newbuild options.
